audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a high-pitched female voice greeting warmly over a quirky, mid-tempo pizzicato BGM. A 'ding' sound effect highlights the text. (2) Vocal tone shifts to a strained, loud shout as a 'boom' explosion sound effect triggers. The BGM becomes tense and percussive, mirroring the 'angry teacher' persona. (3) A sequence of hard cuts follows, each accompanied by a 'whoosh' or 'impact' sound effect as the speaker yells instructions. The piano BGM is fast and chaotic. (4) The audio transitions suddenly to a soft, serene classical piano melody. The female voice becomes calm, gentle, and melodic, with a breathy quality as she begins the product description. (5) A 'splash' sound effect and bubbly synth textures are layered over the voice when hydration is mentioned. (6) The BGM shifts to a bright, commercial pop style with a steady beat. The speaker narrates at a professional, clear broadcasting pace, detailing the 10-year history of the product. (7) Final phase features a upbeat jingle and a clear 'ding' sound effect at the end to emphasize the price and CTA.
